Home / Services / Modular Kitchen Designers

A kitchen in an Indian home works harder than any other room. It handles tadka smoke, heavy vessels, grinding stones and large festival meals, so a kitchen copied from a catalogue rarely survives. We design modular kitchens around how you cook.

Every Manzil Homes kitchen is planned for workflow, storage and easy cleaning, using hardware and finishes chosen to stay smooth and stain-free for years.

Kitchen design details we take care of

  • Layouts that suit the room: L-shaped, U-shaped, parallel or island
  • Vastu-aligned placement of the hob and sink
  • Tall units, corner solutions and pull-out organisers
  • Soft-close drawers and premium hardware
  • Moisture- and stain-resistant carcass and shutter finishes
  • Chimney, appliance and task-lighting planning
WhatsApp Us +91 94920 54954

Built for heat, steam and spice

Coastal humidity can swell poor-quality boards and rust cheap hardware. We specify materials and fittings that resist moisture, and plan ventilation so smoke and steam leave the room instead of the cabinets absorbing them.

We also design for real storage needs: space for bulk grains, pressure cookers, mixers and the pooja items many families keep close to the kitchen.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you redo just my kitchen?

Yes. We design and install modular kitchens as a standalone project or as part of full-home interiors.

Will you show me the kitchen in 3D?

Yes. You see a 3D render with your chosen finishes before production starts.

Is the kitchen layout Vastu compliant?

Yes. Hob and sink positions are planned with Vastu along with workflow.
